items.title: Trump targets Slotkin in call for DOJ probe of alleged Democratic threats to Republicans

items.title: Meta chief strategy officer Dave Wehner leaves to join AI infrastructure startup Fireworks as CFO
items.body_preview: Dave Wehner, Meta’s chief strategy officer, is leaving the company to become CFO of Fireworks, the AI infrastructure startup valued at $17.5 billion in July.

items.title: Syria denies plans to send troops to Yemen as Saudi military ties deepen - Reuters

items.title: Decisive election. Dramatic stock swings. How we handled the market last week

items.title: After midterm rout, Vance tries to build his own 2028 brand - Reuters

items.title: 31-year-old dumpster diver brought in $140,000 in 12 months: I 'did much more than I thought was possible'
items.body_preview: Carter Stevens started reselling discarded items from dumpsters around Nashville, Tennessee, in March 2024. Months earlier, he'd been living in his car.
items.korean_summary: 31세의 카터 스티븐스는 덤스터 다이빙(dumpster diving)을 통해 버려진 물건을 재판매하여 12개월 만에 14만 달러의 수익을 올렸다. 이는 창의적인 방법으로 경제적 성공을 이룬 사례로 주목받는다.

items.title: Mark Cuban says he doesn’t ‘give a f---' about growing his net worth—a healthy mindset for non-billionaires too, a financial therapist says
items.body_preview: The billionaire serial entrepreneur says he cares more about the impact he can have by spending and investing, rather than worrying about amassing more wealth.
items.korean_summary: 억만장자 기업가 마크 큐반은 순자산(net worth) 증가에 무관심하며, 돈을 쓰고 투자하여 미칠 수 있는 영향에 더 집중한다고 밝혔다. 재정 치료사는 이러한 사고방식이 일반인에게도 건강하다고 조언한다.

items.title: Cosm rides premium moviegoing wave with more immersive screenings and a wider library

items.title: Trump makes hardliner Stephen Miller his chief of staff after midterm defeat - Reuters

items.title: 'We have nothing': Displaced mothers in Yemen's Taiz collect plastic to survive - Reuters
items.body_preview: 'We have nothing': Displaced mothers in Yemen's Taiz collect plastic to survive  Reuters

items.title: Top House Oversight Democrat warns Trump family to 'lawyer up'

items.title: Fake job interview scams like the one that hit Binance are getting more sophisticated. Here are the new signs to watch for

items.title: Syria aids Saudi Arabia with military advice and training amid Houthi attacks, sources say - Reuters

items.title: Data center double-down: Hassett says Blue Wave won't stop AI build-out

items.title: Anthropic IPO announcement odds drop on Kalshi following midterms and AI sell-off
